faqs.question: What are your hours of operation?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

faqs.question: How do I submit my internship project?
faqs.answer: You can submit your public GitHub repository link through your Student Workspace.

faqs.question: When will I receive my certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificates are reviewed and issued within 3-5 business days after your code review.

faqs.question: How do I upload my project to GitHub?
faqs.answer: Create a public GitHub repository, upload your project files, and share the repository link through your Student Workspace.

faqs.question: How does the code review process work?
faqs.answer: Your submitted project is reviewed to evaluate its implementation and completion.

faqs.question: What should I do if I face an issue with my task?
faqs.answer: Review the task instructions and check your implementation. For further assistance, contact your internship support team.

faqs.question: Can I get a hard copy of my certificate?
faqs.answer: Please contact your internship support team to confirm whether a physical certificate copy is available.

faqs.question: Can I add my internship certificate to my resume?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can include your internship certificate in your resume after receiving it. You can also add it to your LinkedIn profile.
